research.title: Off Chops is not safely bounded by the last row of an old ranking
research.finding: The inspected HLTV match page lists Ground Zero versus Off Chops at DFRAG Invitational 2026, best of three on LAN. Its betting section exposed a social-casino promotion, not a numeric two-way sportsbook quote. The Off Chops team page lists VRS #129 and three current named starters; the match page lists VRS #130 and five players. These different observations must not be silently combined. The earlier board's assumed strength ceiling from absence in Valve's October 5 file is unsupported. Leave a missing probability blank rather than publish that bound.
research.method: fetch_page, team page chunk 0 and match page chunks 0–1; excerpts reviewed directly, not inferred from a search snippet

research.title: Ground Zero's listed substitute differs from the rating roster
research.finding: HLTV's inspected match lineup shows apocdud, Omichella, vision, tucks (Substitute), and sliimey. Its team overview instead lists apocdud, hazr, sliimey, Omichella, and vision. An old five-player rating tuple matching the organisation name alone does not verify the announced match five. No numerical stand-in penalty is invented.
research.method: fetch_page, Ground Zero team page chunk 0 and match page chunks 0–1

research.title: HLTV live VRS is a different, explicitly beta input
research.finding: The inspected October 21 HLTV ranking labels itself Beta and says it includes matches and secured prize money from unfinished events. The official Valve GitHub directory independently returned standings_global_2026_10_05.md as its newest global file, blob 2aa2805394fbc68f36a5752a5b16026f2ab2fed5. Do not describe October 5 points as today's values or splice beta ranks into a model calibrated on a different source/date.
research.method: fetch_page HLTV ranking chunk 0; gh api official Valve contents directory and file; pinned file hash checked locally

research.title: Pinnacle hub URL does not establish an available price
research.finding: The inspected public /en/esports/cs2-hub URL redirected to a Page Not Found page. A generic sportsbook source link is not verification of a fixture's price. Existing retained API observations must have their own timestamps and raw two-sided odds; this broken hub is not evidence that Pinnacle has no CS2 markets.

research.title: Official HotSpawn lobby rechecked without using pick popularity
research.finding: The inspected rendered lobby has 78 CS2 entries in its tier/tournament filters and 13 open match cards in Closing Soon and Upcoming. The open team pairs agree with the retained 13-row open inventory used for this audit. Four DFRAG cards expose no View Match link in the rendered text; their fixture IDs remain attributable to retained API/transfer-state evidence, not independently confirmed from those text cards. Displayed local dates/times were not assumed to be UTC. HotSpawn popularity percentages are never probability evidence.
research.method: fetch_page lobby chunks 0–1; rendered text read directly; automated audit uses separately timestamped retained transfer-state capture

research.title: Low-tier odds research did not yield a verifiable new book line
research.finding: For benched gods–TitanFlow, Ground Zero–Off Chops, and FlyQuest–Staqued, HLTV-first discovery was followed by esports-odds searches. The inspected EGamersWorld benched gods–TitanFlow page displays 1.8/1.8 with both bet links pointing to its own # anchor, without an identified book or observation time. Those placeholders were rejected, not turned into a 50/50 line. HLTV Ground Zero–Off Chops exposes no numeric two-way price in the inspected betting table. No claim is made that all sportsbooks worldwide were exhausted. Missing opponent ratings or incomplete lineups still require unresolved rows until supported evidence appears.
research.method: web discovery followed by fetch_page EGamersWorld chunk 0 and HLTV match chunks 0–1; non-primary placeholder is rejected, not used as a verified value

research.title: Integration blocker: newly merged audit links escape the staged site
research.finding: After rebasing onto main 7d74dec3, full static staging stops because pickboard/flagged.html links to ../scripts/f7279a54/collect.py and ../scripts/f7279a54/core.py. The files exist in the repository but are not shipped in the staged Pages artifact. This is a newly inherited staging defect, not a missing betting line. The owning session was notified on PR #213 and the active integration owner on PR #215; this session has not edited their claimed files. It does not invalidate the independent audit or source research, but the combined staged build cannot be described as green until fixed.
research.method: Executed scripts/stage_site.py against rebased integration; reviewed source-link renderer and reported exact failing paths
